先从绿洲获得碳矿化，再固化节点。每次成功施法记 1 kg。: Acquire Mineralization at the oasis, then seal the nodes. Each successful cast records 1 kg.
城内有两处绿洲，分别赋予护盾和黑穿。黑穿能够穿过紫色暗壁。: There are two oases in the city, granting Shield and Shadow Pierce. Shadow Pierce can pass through violet dark walls.
靠近居民按 T 交谈，再按 T 阅读下一句。: Press T near a resident to talk, then press T for the next subtitle.

临时承重的晶壳会碎裂，碳仍结合在固态矿石中。\n以上数值为游戏教学模型。:
The temporary crust shatters, but carbon remains bound in solid mineral rubble.
These values are a fictional teaching model.
捕获的二氧化碳与矿物反应，能形成固态碳酸盐。这就是碳矿化。: Captured carbon dioxide reacts with minerals to form solid carbonates. This is carbon mineralization.
矿化后的气柱能暂时承重。平台碎裂后，碳仍留在落下的矿石中。: Mineralized gas can briefly support your weight. When the platform shatters, the carbon stays bound in the fallen rock.
每次有效矿化模拟固定 150 kg CO₂e。数值是关卡教学模型。: Each successful pulse sequesters a simulated 150 kg CO₂e. These values are a teaching model.
空格起跳，再按空格二段跳。E / J：碳矿化脉冲。: Space: jump, then jump again. E / J: mineralization pulse.
在空中释放矿化，把毒气转化成临时晶桥。: Cast in mid-air to turn gas into a temporary bridge.
把木箱推上压板，维持压力以开启主竖井气阀。: Push the crate onto the plate. Keep its weight there to power the shaft.
跳跃、二段跳、矿化、落台。每个中继点都是毒气生成的临时岩台。: Jump, double jump, mineralize, land. Every relay is temporary gas-made rock.
T 或左键操作拉杆，其下方舱门随即开启。: T or left click: operate the lever. The hatch opens below it.
继续前进！晶桥正从左向右连续崩塌。: Keep moving! The bridge collapses from left to right.
窄台仅持续 2.8 秒，落台可恢复二段跳。: Narrow platforms last 2.8 seconds. Land to refresh Double Jump.
已返回检查点，累计固碳量保留。: Checkpoint restored. Your captured-carbon total is retained.
矿坑已修复，沿坡道向左返回垃圾场。: The mine is restored. Follow the ramp left to the Junkyard.
